body.message:
I do not accept your apology at all. It has been around 23 days and you’ve been “following up” on this issue??? Are you kidding me?

You still haven’t even provided me with a second access card during all this time.

I can’t even use the bathroom because the ceiling is leaking and the whole apartment smells like sewage.

So this is what you call “trying to fix the issue” all this time?

That’s fine. When it’s time to pay the rent, I will also have issues, and be sure that I will not respond to you.
